questions.question: 9 is related to 16 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 25 is related to 36. To which of the following is 81 related using the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (√1st number + 1)² = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 9 : 16

⇒ (√9 + 1)² = (3 + 1)² = 4² = 16.

For, 25 : 36

⇒ (√25 + 1)² = (5 + 1)² = 6² = 36.

Similarly, for 81 : ?

**⇒ (√81 + 1)² = (9 + 1)² = 10² = 100.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

2. Tree

3. Furniture

4. Wood

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

5. Plant - When a seed germinates under favorable conditions, it breaks open and a sprout emerges, eventually growing into a plant.

2. Tree - As the plant matures, it may grow into a tree.

4. Wood - Wood is obtained from the trunk of mature trees.

3. Furniture - Wood is then processed and used to make furniture.

So, the order would be: '**1, 5, 2, 4, 3**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All eggs are oats.

All oats are buckets.

All buckets are plastics.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All buckets are eggs.

(II) Some plastics are oats.

(III) All plastics are buckets.

options.text: All the conclusions I, II and III follow
Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/208a69cb259b08db67f4d1a123c57b89950720f2271d909e8bb9b63eac7fc6b6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All buckets are eggs → Does not follow (As all eggs are oats and all oats are buckets. So, it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some plastics are oats → Follow (As all oats are buckets and all buckets are plastics. As all oats comes in buckets which whole comes in plastics, therefore, some plastics are oats is true.)

III. All plastics are buckets → Does not follow (As all buckets are plastics. So, it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows**"

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some fractions are marts.

No mart is a stud. All studs are frogs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some fractions are definitely not studs.

II. Some fractions are definitely not marts.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f1e6443893258d841c69493f3bf958b4f6598038fa7727604914916c59080ac.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some fractions are definitely not studs → Follow (As some fractions are marts and no mart is a stud. As some part of fractions is common with marts which cannot be studs, therefore, some fractions cannot be studs is true.)

II. Some fractions are definitely not marts → Does not follow (As some fractions are marts. As some part of fractions is common with marts, therefore, some fractions cannot be marts is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion I follows"
